$schema.description: Schema location used by JSON-aware editors.

manifestFilename.description: Manifest filename resolved inside a selected vault folder.

projectConfigFilename.description: Optional project configuration filename resolved beside the manifest.

figureReferences.description: How authored prose names figures. The manifest's obsHtml.figures labels always count as labels.

labels.description: Words that, followed by a number, type a figure number in prose (a lint warning).

conjunctions.description: Words that, besides whitespace and a comma, join adjacent unlabelled figure references into one plural reference.

cssSnippetFolder.description: Vault-relative folder, with forward slashes, holding the CSS snippets a manifest's obsHtml.cssSnippets lists.

styleFolder.description: Optional vault-relative folder containing a style.css module; null selects the packaged generic style.

commandTimeoutSeconds.description: Maximum runtime for one authorized cmd fence.

renderedCheckTimeoutSeconds.description: Maximum time --check-rendered waits for the opened HTML to report ready or error.

timings.description: A --timings build warns about a stage only when it exceeds its timing baseline by both thresholds.

relativeThreshold.description: Minimum increase over the baseline as a fraction of it (0.5 is 50 percent).

absoluteThresholdSeconds.description: Minimum increase over the baseline in seconds.

inactiveIconOpacity.description: Shared inactive icon opacity; explanatory text and active icons remain unchanged.

guidedCard.description: Requested size of a guided action card's floating or helper window; browsers may clamp it.

assetIndex.description: Optional vault-relative semantic asset index; null uses packaged resources.

dataCompression.description: Canonical artifact-data transport. Gzip embeds base64 compressed JSON, with plain fallback when smaller; none embeds plain JSON.

embedPdfs.description: Embed PDF attachments; otherwise link to local source files.

tablePageSize.description: Initial items per page in generic tables; readers may choose any positive integer.

tableIconWidthPixels.description: Fixed width of compact table icon slots, in CSS pixels.

tableDetailFontSizePoints.description: Default font size for expanded table subject details, in points.

facetDistinctRatio.description: Largest distinct-value/populated-record ratio offered as a Filter facet.

paragraphWarningLines.description: Estimated prose lines above which the converter warns on stderr.

paragraphLineCharacters.description: Wrapping width for converter-only paragraph diagnostics.

codeFontPoints.description: Base code-fence font size on paper, before PDF long-line fitting.

headingSpaceBeforeEm.description: Shared section-heading leading space in body em units.

headingSpaceAfterEm.description: Shared heading-to-content space in body em units.

paragraphMinimumLines.description: Minimum paragraph lines on each side of a feasible PDF split.

pingPeriodMilliseconds.description: Duration of one outward attention ring; 250ms produces four pulses per second.

pingCount.description: Number of attention rings in one finite burst.

pingScale.description: Terminal scale of the fading attention border relative to its target.

plotlyDelivery.description: Embed Plotly for offline interaction, or load the pinned integrity-checked CDN asset.

proseWidthMultiplier.description: Maximum ordinary figure width as a multiple of the prose column.

viewportGutterRem.description: Minimum space on each side of a figure at the reader viewport edges.

viewportHeightRatio.description: Maximum ordinary image height as a fraction of the reading viewport height; enlargement and print retain their own sizing.

paper.description: Physical paper geometry; a manifest's obsHtml.print resolves to it and must stay within these limits.

print.description: Print catalogue; each document chooses its paper and margin in the manifest's obsHtml.print.

paperSizes.description: Paper names a manifest's obsHtml.print.paper may choose, with their portrait dimensions.

borderedTags.description: Tag kinds that opt into the shared neutral card outline.
